answer.new_information: Alphabet Q2 2026 Google Cloud segment revenue of $24.8bn, up 82% year over year, with backlog above $500bn versus $462bn in Q1 (quarter period, segment definition). Period and definition are Alphabet's Google Cloud, not an NVDA metric, so no mapping to an NVDA question is stated. Nothing in the record is verifiable from the text beyond the publisher's figures, and the article's claim that Alphabet is an Nvidia customer is not supported by any stored piece here.
